|===

What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `bearssl`: BearSSL at webcpp::crypto's pin: bearssl_hash.h states constant time for its GHASH implementations alone, not for br_md5_*, br_sha1_*, br_sha224_* to br_sha512_* or br_md5sha1_*.
* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.
* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man7/EVP_MD-*.pod, doc/man3/EVP_DigestInit.pod and providers/implementations/digests/ state no constant-time property.
* `sodium`: libsodium 1.0.22: its headers state constant time for comparisons (sodium/utils.h) alone, not for its hashing, MAC, key derivation and password hashing functions (crypto_hash_*, crypto_xof_*, crypto_generichash_*, crypto_shorthash_*, crypto_auth_*, crypto_kdf_*, crypto_pwhash_*).
* `webcrypto`: The Web Cryptography API (W3C Recommendation, 2017) states no constant-time property of digest, sign or deriveBits; each JavaScript runtime's implementation decides, and webcpp reads none.

`digests::md5_sha1` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `digests::md5`, `digests::sha1`, `digests::sha2_224` and `digests::sha2_384`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `bearssl`, `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `digests::sha2_256` and `digests::sha2_512`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `bearssl`, `openssl`, `sodium` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `digests::sha2_512_224` and `digests::sha2_512_256`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).

`webcrypto` serves the asynchronous family alone, on Emscripten, where the type of its asynchronous call names it (<<hash-async-webcrypto>>).
